evidence_notes: AHA/RCUK are independent editorial groups with common ILCOR evidence. Explicit source-text regions preserved. No shock to asystole, no universal prognosis or cooling target, no individual drug doses. NIH defibrillator page permits contact after one/two resolved shocks while UK Royal Free escalates more than one in quick succession; article uses the UK urgent pathway and records this difference. Unsupported swallowing/nutrition-specific referral sentence was removed during author source check; dietary pattern remains cross-supported. Author checks are not clinical sign-off. Newborn transition outside scope; newborn topic owned by maternal agent.
